review.stable: All three identify the intended four view classes, two lift-up fronts, two long-run drawers and zero legs. Control 3 spells all island enums incorrectly.
review.major_failure: Control 3 recognizes the perpendicular wing and three drawers in its final uncertainty but counts only view 003, citing possible overlap. Same evidence and correct semantic view class do not ensure physical-identity reconciliation. This is a concrete failure mechanism in the output, not proof of model-internal reasoning.
review.overlay: All three exact detail overlays inspected. Control 3 display uses enum aliases only; raw response remains failed. Run 1 return-wing boxes have noticeable vertical offsets. Counts alone are insufficient acceptance.
review.conclusion: Fixed-request variability confirmed. Two controls preserve drawer/lift counts; none establishes full semantic correctness. Three samples cannot estimate a production error rate.
review.decision: Stop after exactly three approved calls. Keep Front V2 / Planner V4 defaults and protected checkpoint, no prompt change, output repair or deployment.
review.next_proposed: Test one bounded identity rule: do not suppress a different wing as duplicate merely on possible overlap; duplicate removal needs a specific same-physical-front correspondence. Keep output enum compliance as a separate issue, not a substitute for coverage.
